B.choice: Replace blocking client lifecycle with server-owned durable atomic unit publication and reconciliation
specificMechanism: A bounded server-owned attempt/session is durably registered and identifiable before any health payload; a supervisor owns its immutable process epoch and every reader/clone/late command.

One short original-authority transaction atomically validates full authoritative source/generation/privacy/lease preimage, applies bounded effects, appends original receipts and stores the signed unit terminal outcome/journal. Partial work is explicitly partial; no artificial EOF.

Lost ACK reads the same original durable journal by original identity and validates its receipt digest/signature/generation. It never reruns work, renews original authority, or emits expired/private health output.

An orphan reaper obtains affirmative server terminal/no-future-command evidence plus local worker/dependent-health-copy disposal proof before removing the exact signed hold. Unknown remains fail-closed. Cleanup grants erasure authority only, not new work/finalization.
B.hardDependency: Current evidence provides no Turso server-session termination/finality guarantee suitable for orphan disposal. If unavailable, B requires an owner-approved deployment/topology with an owned database worker/service that provides this proof. No infrastructure move or Production migration is authorized by this decision.
B.whyNotCurrentDelivery: Requires a new server ownership contract and targeted qualification, not an already reviewed implementation. No substitute TTL is accepted.
